To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the inductor quality and the efficiency of IPT systems depend on the frequency of the magnetic field, that the magnetic coupling is determined by the area enclosed by both coils, and that a high magnetic coupling can be reached with a low number of windings.

the inductance of the coils can be increased by increasing the area enclosed by them, that the inductors' quality factors can be increased by decreasing their dimensions, that the magnetic coupling between the coils can be improved by increasing the area of the coils, that the efficiency of the power transfer can be improved by decreasing the dimensions of the inductors, that the magnetic field emissions can be reduced by decreasing the dimensions and the number of the coils, and that the power density can be increased by
for a given power level the magnetic coupling of the coils can be optimized with respect to the area enclosed by them, and the quality factor of each coil with respect to its inductance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an efficient and compact IPT system.
the optimization of magnetic designs for inductive power transmission systems with respect to high efficiency and high transmission power.
the design of IPT coils for a high magnetic coupling at any power level and with a high quality factor for a maximum efficiency.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the magnetic coupling is the most important factor in the efficiency of IPT systems.
the magnetic coupling is mainly dependent on the area enclosed and that the shape has only a secondary influence.
the magnetic coupling is a very important factor for IPT systems and that it is not necessary to optimize the magnetic design with a high degree of complexity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the magnetic coupling of IPT systems is mainly determined by the area enclosed by both coils.
the inductor quality is the main factor limiting the efficiency of an IPT system.
the efficiency of IPT systems can be optimized by the use of coils with high inductor quality factors and a high magnetic coupling.
The main takeaway from our work is that
for IPT systems the quality factor is the most critical parameter and that the magnetic coupling is not the most critical parameter as it was assumed so far.
the magnetic design of IPT coils is mainly driven by the required magnetic coupling.
the magnetic coupling is the most important parameter for the design of inductive power transfer systems.
